**Daily Ops: Decryption** is a Daily Op in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Locked & Loaded* update.

| Daily Ops: Decryption | | | | | | 
| Enter further into the location to start the quest timer. | | | | | | 
| Track and Eliminate Enemies | | | | | | 
| Eliminate Carrier to Obtain First Code | | | | | | 
| Disable Any Radio Interceptor | | | | | | 
| Track and Eliminate Enemies | | | | | | 
| Eliminate Carrier to Obtain Second Code | | | | | | 
| Disable Either Remaining Radio Interceptor | | | | | | 
| Track and Eliminate Enemies | | | | | | 
| Eliminate Enemy Leader to Obtain Final Code | | | | | | 
| Disable the Final Radio Interceptor | | | | | | 
| Reward: 300 XP, 25-500 | | | | | | 

Upon joining the Daily Op, Initiate Dodge will contact the player characters, starting the timer for the duration the Daily Op takes to complete. He asks that they track and eliminate enemies to attract the code carriers. At this point, the first eight enemies listed in the Daily Op will start attacking. These enemies have been scattered across the map. Dodge will also warn to maintain stealth or be quick with the kills as the enemies are much stronger than usual and can down a player in short order if allowed to group up or detects them.

Once the first eight enemies have been killed, Dodge will then request that players to eliminate the Code Carrier. Normally these carriers will spawn close to at least one of the radio interceptors and at least three will be marked that need to be eliminated due to Dodge being unsure which one is the Code Carrier. Once the first carrier had been killed, Dodge will then request that the players shut down an interceptor. After that, the sequence is repeated for the second interceptor, requiring 10 enemies this time to spawn the trio of Code Carriers because of Dodge's inaccurate intel, then once more with killing 12 of them to attract the enemy leader, which Dodge identifies as the final Code Carrier due to more accurate info. Finally, Dodge assigns the players to eliminate the enemy leader for the final code.

After defeating the enemy leader, the final step is to disable the Final Radio Interceptor. After this, Dodge calls in to report mission accomplished. Players will then teleport back to the location that they were at prior to joining the op, and depending on how quick the op was finished, rewards will be given accordingly.

**Note:** *Items marked with * may only be received if that plan has not already been learned.*
